feature: HLA-restricted immunotherapy handles (HA-1/HA-2 TCR-T, WT1, PRAME) - the primary reason for this Libby run
test_name: High-resolution HLA class I typing (allele-level HLA-A*02:01 and HLA-A*24:02)
tissue_type: whole blood (EDTA); allele-level ~2020 transplant typing report acceptable if retrievable
rationale: Resolves the HLA-A*02:01 (and HLA-A*24:02) allele status that gates every HLA-restricted lever named for this case: HA-1/HA-2 TCR-T (TSC-100/101), WT1-C4, and PRAME-directed T cells are all presented on HLA-A*02:01, with A*24:02 opening a WT1-siTCR alternative if A*02:01 is negative (nct:NCT05473910). The allele-level result was generated at the ~2020 transplant workup but is not in the records on hand, so retrieve that report first and repeat high-resolution typing only if it cannot be confirmed at allele level. Without a confirmed allele call none of the HLA-restricted approaches, the stated reason for this run, can be scoped.
tissue_required_estimate: 5-10 mL whole blood (EDTA); allele-level 2020 typing record acceptable if retrievable
decision_gated: HLA-A*02:01/A*24:02-restricted immunotherapy eligibility (TSC-100/101, WT1-C4, WT1-siTCR, PRAME-directed T cells)

feature: HLA-restricted immunotherapy handles (HA-1/HA-2 TCR-T, WT1, PRAME) - the primary reason for this Libby run
test_name: HA-1 / HA-2 minor histocompatibility antigen genotyping (recipient and HLA-identical sibling donor)
tissue_type: whole blood (EDTA) from patient AND sibling donor
rationale: Establishes the recipient HA-1(H)-positive / donor HA-1-negative (or HA-2) mismatch that HA-directed TCR-T requires; HLA-identical siblings can still differ at these minor histocompatibility loci, so both the patient and the sibling donor must be genotyped (pmid:9820596, pmid:31275297). Multiplex or allele-specific PCR resolves the HA-1H/HA-1R and HA-2 alleles from whole blood. Skipping the donor sample leaves TSC-100/101 eligibility (nct:NCT05473910) undetermined even when HLA-A*02:01 is confirmed.
tissue_required_estimate: 5-10 mL whole blood (EDTA) from patient and sibling donor
decision_gated: TSC-100/TSC-101 HA-1/HA-2 TCR-T (ALLOHA, NCT05473910); requires recipient-positive/donor-negative MiHA mismatch

test_name: Retrieval of the 2019 diagnostic TP53 variant identity and VAF (original NGS report)
tissue_type: no new specimen; 2019 diagnostic NGS report and variant file
rationale: Retrieves the exact amino-acid change and VAF from the 2019 diagnostic NGS so the 2019-mutant versus 2026-negative discrepancy can be adjudicated without down-calling to wild-type on a 2%-LOD panel that reads no copy number. A documented Y220C at diagnosis would directly support rezatapopt (nct:NCT06616636); any other TP53 variant would not. Acting on the limited 2026-negative result alone risks discarding a Y220C handle that the original report may already name.
tissue_required_estimate: No new specimen; original 2019 NGS report and variant call file
notes: Records action, not a new assay; request the annotated variant table (HGVS p. change and VAF) from the 2019 testing laboratory.

test_name: CNV-capable heme NGS panel with TP53 variant-level readout (Y220C determination)
tissue_type: fresh bone marrow aspirate at relapse (EDTA); high-blast peripheral blood acceptable
rationale: Determines at relapse whether the TP53 aberration is the Y220C variant using a copy-number-capable heme NGS panel with adequate sensitivity, rather than the 2%-LOD assay that reported negative without CNV calling. Y220C-positive disease is the specific handle for the Y220C-selective reactivator rezatapopt (nct:NCT06616636); non-Y220C or truly absent TP53 aberration removes that option. A single limited panel cannot exclude subclonal or copy-loss TP53 events, so a CNV-aware orthogonal read is needed before the target is called present or absent.
tissue_required_estimate: Fresh bone marrow aspirate at relapse (EDTA); high-blast peripheral blood acceptable

tissue_type: fresh bone marrow aspirate or peripheral blood (viable cells)
rationale: Converts the qualitative CD33-positive call into a quantitative antigen-density measure (ABC/MESF) that predicts benefit from CD33-directed ADC therapy, since low surface density blunts gemtuzumab ozogamicin activity. Request the density read on the same flow specimen used for phenotyping. Qualitative positivity alone does not establish whether the ADC handle is strong enough to act on.
tissue_required_estimate: Fresh bone marrow aspirate or peripheral blood (heparin/EDTA), viable cells
decision_gated: Gemtuzumab ozogamicin (CD33 ADC); dual CD33/CD123 targeting

tissue_type: fresh bone marrow aspirate or peripheral blood (viable cells)
rationale: Quantifies CD123 surface density on blasts to support selection among CD123-directed agents (tagraxofusp immunotoxin, pivekimab sunirine ADC), which target an antigen expressed on most AML blasts and leukemic stem cells (pmid:38423051). Request antigen-density flow on the phenotyping specimen. Without a density read, CD123-directed cytoreduction ahead of a cellular or transplant consolidation is chosen blind to the predictive marker.

test_name: PRAME expression on blasts (flow or qRT-PCR / RNA)
tissue_type: fresh bone marrow or peripheral blood; FFPE for IHC
rationale: Measures PRAME expression on blasts to establish whether the PRAME-directed lever (PRAME TCR-T / ImmTAC, HLA-A*02:01-restricted) has a target present, since PRAME expression in AML is variable rather than universal. Assess by flow or qRT-PCR on marrow or blood; commercial heme-specific PRAME assays are limited, so a send-out or academic RNA read may be needed. If PRAME is low or absent that pathway drops regardless of HLA-A*02:01 status.
tissue_required_estimate: Fresh bone marrow or peripheral blood; FFPE marrow clot for IHC

test_name: p53 protein immunohistochemistry (overexpression vs null pattern)
rationale: Adds an orthogonal protein read of p53: a strong-overexpression or complete-null pattern corroborates a functionally aberrant TP53, while normal wild-type staining argues against it, helping adjudicate the 2019-versus-2026 NGS discrepancy (guideline:eln-aml-2022). It runs on archival FFPE marrow, so it costs no new procedure. On its own IHC does not identify the specific variant, so it supports but does not replace variant-level NGS.
tissue_required_estimate: Archival FFPE bone marrow core or clot section
decision_gated: Corroborates TP53-aberrant call feeding the rezatapopt decision; not variant-level

providers.notes: Hematopathology reference lab; p53 IHC pattern interpretation (overexpression vs null) needs experienced heme readers.

tissue_type: bone marrow aspirate or FFPE; archival acceptable
rationale: Detects 17p/TP53 copy loss that a 2%-LOD, no-CNV sequencing panel cannot see, addressing the most likely explanation (copy loss or subclonal loss) for the 2026 negative result. A deletion supports a multi-hit TP53 state with its adverse prognosis and reframes the discrepancy without collapsing it to wild-type (guideline:eln-aml-2022). Omitting FISH leaves a plausible copy-loss mechanism unexamined.
tissue_required_estimate: Bone marrow aspirate (sodium heparin) or FFPE; archival acceptable
decision_gated: TP53 copy-loss / multi-hit status; supports TP53-aberrant call and prognosis

providers.name: Mayo Clinic Laboratories

test_name: STR chimerism on flow-sorted CD34+ blasts (recipient vs donor origin)
tissue_type: fresh bone marrow (EDTA) with CD34+ sorting; paired donor STR on file
rationale: Confirms that the relapse arises from recipient-origin leukemia (evolution of the original clone) rather than a donor-derived or secondary leukemia by running STR chimerism on flow-sorted CD34+ blasts; the sex-matched sibling donor rules out XY-FISH as a shortcut. Recipient-origin relapse with shared del(5q)/del(7q) supports a second-transplant plus donor-lymphocyte or HA-directed cellular strategy, whereas donor-derived leukemia would redirect the plan. Unsorted chimerism can be diluted by normal donor hematopoiesis and miss the blast compartment.
tissue_required_estimate: Fresh bone marrow (EDTA) with CD34+ sorting; archived donor STR profile
decision_gated: Clonal origin of relapse; informs HCT2 vs DLI vs alternative-donor strategy

providers.name: Versiti Diagnostic Laboratories
providers.notes: Offers lineage-specific / sorted-cell STR chimerism; CD34+-sorted chimerism is the readout needed to attribute relapse to the blast compartment.

test_name: Full metaphase karyotype plus MECOM and KMT2A FISH at relapse
rationale: Obtains a full metaphase karyotype plus targeted FISH for MECOM rearrangement and KMT2A amplification at relapse, confirming the adverse cytogenetic features that shape prognosis and trial eligibility. These lesions were reported on the 2026 panel and carry adverse risk under current AML frameworks (guideline:eln-aml-2022). Without a complete relapse karyotype, risk stratification and several trial screens rest on an incomplete cytogenetic picture.
tissue_required_estimate: Fresh bone marrow aspirate (sodium heparin), 2-3 mL
decision_gated: Adverse-cytogenetics confirmation (MECOM, KMT2A amplification) for prognosis and trial eligibility

tissue_type: whole blood or bone marrow (germline; buccal acceptable)
rationale: Genotypes the CD33 rs12459419 splicing SNP: the CC genotype retains the IgV epitope and predicts substantially better gemtuzumab ozogamicin response, while the T allele reduces surface CD33 and blunts benefit (pmid:28644774). It refines whether a CD33-ADC lever is worth pursuing alongside the antigen-density read. Not gating on its own, but a CT/TT result tempers expectations for gemtuzumab ozogamicin.
tissue_required_estimate: Whole blood or bone marrow (germline-inferred; buccal swab acceptable)
decision_gated: Refines gemtuzumab ozogamicin benefit prediction; not gating
